file_name.help: Name of the CCL file to write.

objects.help: List of objects to save. An empty list will save all objects.

export_ccl.help: Export a file containing some or all CCL definitions.

import_mesh.help: Import a mesh file into the current CFX-Pre session.

recover_case_file.help:
For CFX-Solver input files, locate and open the original case
        file (.cfx) instead.

replace_flow_data.help:
For CFX-Solver input files, when the original case file is
        recovered, use the simulation setup (CCL) in the CFX-Solver
        input file and not the original case file.

open_case.help:
Open a case file. Supported formats include:
- CFX files (*.cfx, *.def, *.res, *.mdef, *.mres)
- CCL files (*.ccl)
- Meshing files (*.cmdb, *.dsdb)
- CFX Mesh files (*.gtm)

file_name.help: Name of the image file to save.

format.help:
The image format. Allowed values include:
        - 'png': Portable Network Graphics (PNG)
        - 'avz': Ansys Viewer Format
        - 'jpg': JPEG
        - 'ppm': Portable Pixel Map (PPM)
        - 'ps':  PostScript
        - 'eps': Encapsulated PostScript.

use_white_background.help: Save the image with a white background.

use_transparent_background.help:
Save the image with a transparent background (PNG images
        only). Needs GPU rendering to be available and enabled.

use_enhanced_output.help:
Process the image with antialiasing. Not available with GPU
        rendering.

use_screen_size.help:
When this is enabled, the saved image will have the same
        height and width (in pixels) as the current viewer size.

image_size_option.help:
Set the image size option. Only applicable if 'Use Screen
        Size' is disabled. Allowed values are 'HD', 'FHD',
        'QHD', '4k', '8k' and 'Custom'.

image_height.help:
Set the image height in pixels. Only applicable if the image
        size option  is set to 'Custom' and 'Use Screen Size' is
        disabled.

image_width.help:
Set the image width in pixels. Only applicable if the image
        size option  is set to 'Custom' and 'Use Screen Size' is
        disabled.

image_scale.help:
Scale the size of bitmap images to a fraction (in percent) of
        the current viewer window size. Only applicable if 'Use
        Screen Size' is enabled.

image_quality.help:
Specify the image quality (JPEG images only). A value of 100
        specifies the highest quality; a value of 1 specifies
        the lowest quality.

tolerance.help:
Increasing the tolerance should result in faster image
        generation, but may introduce defects in the output.
        The default is 1.0e-04, with a range from 0 to 1. Not
        available with GPU rendering.

save_picture.help: Saves an image of the current view.
